title: Researchers find Optimizely serving malicious JavaScript to sites of 178 orgs including Zoom, CNN, HSBC, Salesforce, GitLab, Ledger, BBC, Equifax, IKEA, more (Scott Helme/Report URI Blog)
summary: Scott Helme / Report URI Blog: Researchers find Optimizely serving malicious JavaScript to sites of 178 orgs including Zoom, CNN, HSBC, Salesforce, GitLab, Ledger, BBC, Equifax, IKEA, more — On 16 November 2026, malicious JavaScript was served to visitors of 178 organisations through the Optimizely Web experimentation platform.
